update.releaseNotes:
v5.9.1 - Changelog
New --- - Add hand-picked races to the Schedule calendar. Pick a specific race for any turn and the bot runs it on that turn, and the Smart Race Solver plans the rest of the career around it. - Add a "Rest Instead of a Lone Low-Value Training" setting under Training, on by default. Below 50% energy, when every other training is too risky and the one left gives a small main stat gain, the bot takes the recreation date or rests instead. The training is kept if it still builds a bond, has a skill hint, is a rainbow or has a Spirit Explosion ready. - Add TP reading on Scenario Select. Career Setup now notices the TP Cost Halved event, stops before starting a career it cannot pay for, and ticks Event Boost only when the TP covers the doubled cost. - Add a warning under "Start the Next Career When Done" while the Career Complete skill plan is off, since leftover skill points are lost when the next career starts automatically. - Add basic fallback for when the `View Results` button could not be found.
Adjustments --- - Update game data up to `Kitasan Black (New Year) 2026-10-20`. - Remove the game-in-front check at run start and on resume, so the bot no longer pauses a second time right after you resume it. - Recompute screen regions at the start of every run, so a run started while the screen was rotated no longer leaves later runs searching the wrong areas.
Fixes --- - Fix the bot getting stuck when started from Home with a career already in progress. - Fix the bot getting stuck on the "Career Complete" dialog when set to start the next career. - Fix a forced race from an Insufficient Fans or goal popup being lost when the popup shows at the start of a turn. - Fix a failed recreation date tapping the popup instead of closing it and resting. - Fix the bot not rereading the date after an infirmary visit used up the turn. - Fix the Club daily not requesting a new item when the expired request's label was missed.
